comments.author: polkaranger323
comments.body_html: Love the idea of the mod, but I’ve run into a problem. A friend and I have tried creating our own rewards list in the config, adding weapon and armor presets as additional awards (we cut the currency reward down to compensate). However, when we’re awarded a weapon or armor, it only gives us the base item. I’ve double checked that we did put the preset IDs in, and not the BASE item ID, but the mod seems to only award a singular item, and thus only gives the receiver or armor with no plates. This is critical for armor rigs, apparently, because the “Built in” side, groin, neck, and butt armor parts will have no parts on them, and they’re considered “Unfunctional” meaning we can’t even equip it. Is there any way to allow presets to be used in the configs? I should note: We’re playing on Fika, and we have double checked that the Server, myself, and my friend all have the same config file to ensure compatibility. The mod is functional, and it does work, but the rewards are giving singular items even when the ID is calling to award a Preset.
